text: Oh, it's the guest. Long time no see!\nWait, why are you with Jeila?\nMoreover, why are you in a place like this?
Likewise, why are you here?\nI'm sure mother warned you not to come near here?!
I-I know!\nI came here to look for Olant and Potumkin!
Y-yeah!\nZoe will be angry if she knows, so I came to bring\nthem back.
Sigh......\nYou came here just because of that? What are you\nplanning to do...
Leave this to us, you just go and wait at the\nentrance cuz those two might come out.
What the?! This room is insane.\nToo many monsters!
Somebody help!\nAt this rate, I won't be able to get out!
That's Olant's voice.\nHe seems to be trapped in the room at the back.
It can't be helped, I'll try to find Olant.\nI'll let you deal with them!
Phew. Looks like we're good now...
Olant, you may come out now.
Thank god. Oh, no, Potumkin got separated from me\ntoo...
You see the consequences of disobeying mother!\nJacky is waiting at the entrance, just go there\nfor now.
Oh, Jacky's here too. I got it!
Isn't it Potumkin's voice?\nWhere are you exactly?
I dunno, pom.\nI can hear you tho.\nI think I'm trapped in a weird place, pom...
He seems to have got caught in some kind of\nstrange trap. The way to set him free must be\nsomewhere here...Let's find it!
Let's search the Study and rescue Potumkin.
The search will be reset if you move from the\nStudy or are disconnected from the internet.

Looks like it's a secret chamber, but Potumkin's\nnot there. We need to keep looking.
Ah! Finally I got out pom!
We finally found you!\nJeez, that was time-consuming!!
That invisible magic or whatever it was surely was\nannoying...
That's why I told you not to do things that upset\nmother. Jacky and Olant are waiting at the\nentrance, just go there first......
Ah, Jacky has been found, pom?
I thought she said she came to look for you\nguys, no?
?? Jacky was the one who came out with the idea of\ncoming here, pom.
But OIant and I got separated from Jacky midway,\nso we were looking for her, pom.
W-well, whatever.\nFor now, return to the entrance and just go back\nto mother once you see them.
For God's sake, Jacky...\nShe needs to be scolded harshly by mother once she\ngets home.
Still, what's father doing!\nI won't feel at ease unless I complain!
What?! The door is open.\nFather must be inside.
Nothing feels wrong so far.\nThis place should still be safe...
Umm, I guess we'd better search and check it\nagain...
Oh! Perfect timing!!\nAs you heard what my wife and children said, they\nare starting to worry about my mansion's safety...
Maybe! Probably! Absolutely! Basically!\nI hope it's safe, but who knows.
Since you managed to reach the deepest part of my\nmansion with my daughter and defeat my clone,
could you go and explore it once again?
With your skill, it won't take long, huh?
I'd be happy if you agree to do it because there's\nno guarantee that those kids won't sneak in again.
Excellent! I'm expecting a lot from you.\nWell then, I'll strike a cool pose here while\nwaiting for you.
Can't you just wait normally? Besides, it's not a\ngood idea to leave everything to the guest, we\nshould check the other corners of the mansion too.
Hm? Yeah, if possible, the sooner the better...\nBut I guess you have other stuff to do too. So,\njust prepare food and clothes for 3 months...
How long are you planning to keep the guest here?
It's too long? I was just trying to offer more\ntime since the guest doesn't seem to want to go\nright now.
Really! You're willing to go now!\nThanks, I'm counting on you!
It's not a good idea to leave everything to the\nguest, we should check the other corners of the\nmansion too.
What? Is it really okay, Zoe?
But...I don't feel like getting in here again.
Me neither...I have had enough of this place, pom.
Just stay close to me and you'll be fine.\nC'mon, follow me!
Besides, there's me too! No need to worry!!
I'm worried about you the most, you know...
Well, I'll go with the guest then!
